entities.name: NuoN / NDH-1 subunit N
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q64Y15 from Bacteroides fragilis; length 483 aa.
Predicted multi-pass inner-membrane protein; highly hydrophobic sequence with Pfam Proton_antipo_M (PF00361.26), positions 131–420.
Component of the membrane sector of bacterial respiratory complex I (NDH-1).

entities.name: Respiratory complex I
observations: NDH-1 transfers electrons from NADH through FMN and Fe-S centers to quinones and couples this chemistry to proton translocation.
The membrane sector includes NuoA, NuoH, NuoJ, NuoK, NuoL, NuoM, and NuoN.

entities.name: ATP synthesis coupled electron transport
observations: The protein is annotated in the biological process GO:0042773 through its role in proton-motive-force generation by respiratory complex I.
